text:
Sasha: Quick follow-up from Saturday's outage. I'd like to formalize a postmortem follow-up cadence and an IC rotation so remediations don't stall.
Kevin: Agreed. We lost momentum after the initial RCA last time.
Maria: What cadence are you thinking? quick checks vs formal reviews?
Sasha: Proposal: T0 = incident declared. T+24h = assign remediation owner + brief RCA summary. T+72h = remediation plan (owners + ETAs). T+14d = verification with test evidence. T+30d = closure review + recurrence/pattern analysis.
Aj: Add automated reminders at T+24h, T+72h, T+14d, T+30d. OpsTracker should ping owners and post a status snapshot.
OpsTracker: Reminders scheduled for thread 1871004321: T+24h, T+72h, T+14d, T+30d. Will post ownership summary and outstanding items.
Priya: For IC rotation: monthly rotate among on-call leads. If the assigned IC is unavailable, fallback to previous on-call. Require an IC handoff note in-thread using a short template.
Kevin: Template suggestion:
```
IC Handoff:
- Outgoing IC: name
- Incoming IC: name
- Quick summary (2-3 bullets)
- Open actions: owner + ETA
- Next check-in timezone-aware
```
Sasha: Also: remediation owner must be distinct from IC. IC coordinates; remediation owner owns the fix.
Maria: At T+30, mark a "pattern review" if recurrence suspected and tag Research/Infra to cross-check logs.
Aj: Weekly 15m remediation sync for items older than 7 days could help unblock long-running fixes.
Priya: External comms: keep status posts until T+72h, then publish a consolidated postmortem after closure. Legal/Comms cc for regulated customers.
Kevin: Suggest SLAs as guidance: P1 ack in 12h, mitigation in 72h, targeted remediation 7-14d. Mark as pilot for 90 days.
Sasha: I'll draft a one-pager runbook (cadence, IC rota, acceptance criteria for closing actions: owner confirms, test evidence attached, docs updated) and drop in #eng-oncall for pilot signups.
Maria: OpsTracker: can you create a board view filtered by incident tag so owners can see all open items?
OpsTracker: Board "Incident Remediations" created and synced for incidents tagged #1871+. Filter: tag:incident AND status:open.
Sasha: Thanks everyone. Pilot volunteers?
Aj: I'll join.
Priya: me too.
Kevin: count me in.
